div.head: A Commentarie vpon the 11. Chapter of the Epistle to the Hebrewes.

q.p: Now Faith is the ground of things which are hoped for: and the euidence of things not seene.

div.p: COncerning Faith, 2. points are necessary to be knowne of euery Christian; the doctrine & the practise of it.

q.p: For, by it our Elders were well reported of.

div.p: THis verse containeth the second effect of sauing faith ▪ which is, that faith is a meanes whereby a beleeuer is approued of God.

div.head: Abels Faith.

q.p: By Faith, Abell offred vnto God a greater sacrifice then Cain: by which he obtayned witnesse that he was righteous; God testifying of his gifts: By which faith hee also being dead yet speaketh.

div.p: THe second part of the Chapter, containeth an illustration and proofe of the former description, by a rehearsall of the most excellent patternes and exsamples of faith.

div.head: The second is of Henoch: in these words;2. Example, Henoch. By faith Henoch was translated, that he should not see death, Verse 5. neither was he found, for God tooke him away: for, before he was translated, he was reported of that hee had pleased God, &c.
div.p: THe second example of faith, is taken also out of the old world, before the floud; and it is of Henoch the seauenth from Adam: to whom, strange and miraculous things befell, by reason of his faith.
Let the meaning of the words be first examined.

div.head: Noahs Faith.

q.p: By Faith, Noah being warned of God of the things which were as yet not seene, moued with reuerence, prepared the Arke to the sauing of his houshold.

div.p: IN this verse is contained the third exsample, 3. Exsample of Noah. and the last in order of those who liued afore the floud, in the first and olde world; namely, of the renowned Patriarke Noah, the tenth from Adam.

div.head: Beleeuers vnder the Maccabees.

q.p: Others also were racked, and would not bee deliuered, that they might receiue a better resurrection.

div.p: IN these words, the author of this Epistle proceedes to the fourth order of Examples of faith, contained in this Chapter.

q.p: God prouiding a better thing for vs, that they without vs should not be made perfect.

div.p: BEcause some man might much maruel, that such men as receiued testimony of God for their faith, should not yet receiue the promise; therefore here the holy Ghost renders a reason thereof.

div.head: A Commentarie vpon part of the 12. Chapter to the Hebrewes.

q.p: Wherfore, let vs also, seeing wee are compassed with so great a clowd of witnesses, cast away euery thing that presseth down, and that sinne that hangeth so fast on: let vs runne with patience the race that is set before vs.

div.p: IN these words, the holy Ghost propoundeth a worthy exhortation to the Christians of the newe Testament.
